title: Conflict 1s tiebreak window is strictly-less-than, excluding the exact 1000ms boundary
evidence: goanna/internal/conflict/conflict.go:60 uses `abs64(diffMS) < 1000`; a diff of exactly 1000ms falls to the timestamp branch instead of the version tiebreak. Spec/REQUIREMENTS R4 says 'within 1000ms'.
suggestion: Use `<=` if the window is meant to be inclusive; the fixtures only exercise the same-instant (0ms) case so this edge is untested either way.

title: Line coverage is 60.5% — several tool/error branches unexercised
evidence: scores.json test_coverage=0.605; tools_conformance only asserts entity-id sets, and error paths (unknown room/device, find_path not-found, update of missing entity) plus background-resync in main.go have no direct tests.
suggestion: Add negative-path tool tests and a syncclient error-path test to lift branch coverage; requirement R11 (tests execute) already passes.

title: Durable cache is a single JSON snapshot rewritten wholesale on every mutation
evidence: goanna/internal/graph/store.go:107-123 persist() marshals the entire snapshot and atomically renames on each Flush; every CreateEntity/UpdateEntity/sync triggers a full-graph rewrite (O(n) per write).
suggestion: Acceptable for a local cache and satisfies R6 ('embedded DB or equivalent'); consider an embedded KV/SQLite store if the graph grows large. No action needed for conformance.

title: Reserved protocol fields round-trip correctly as raw JSON
evidence: goanna/internal/protocol/protocol.go:21-22,80-81 keep vector_clock and cursor as json.RawMessage (omitempty), never interpreted — satisfies R1's reserved-field round-trip clause.

title: Version counter is process-monotonic (mod 1e6), not the reference perf-counter
evidence: goanna/internal/version/version.go:41-43 NextCounter uses an atomic monotonic counter rather than the reference perf_counter%1e6; documented in the package comment and fixture-verified by TestVersionFormat.
suggestion: None — format output matches fixtures/version-strings.json; deviation is internal and documented.
